plugins.name: Client keys
plugins.description: Policies per CLIProxyAPI client API key: which models a key may use and see in model lists, and whether it may use the OpenAI Responses API. Set them on a Management Center page.
plugins.author: Whexy

plugins.name: Extra Models
plugins.description: Adds model IDs to a built-in provider such as Codex, Claude or Antigravity before the CLIProxyAPI model catalog lists them, so that provider's accounts serve a new model on release day. Entries use the catalog's own format.
plugins.author: Whexy

plugins.name: Model Groups
plugins.description: Publishes one model ID per group of models served by CLIProxyAPI, for example auto-group/fast, and routes each request to one of the group's models by round robin, weighted round robin or fill first. Groups and their members are managed on a Management Center page; CLIProxyAPI keeps choosing the provider account.
plugins.author: Whexy

plugins.name: OpenCode Go
plugins.description: Serves an OpenCode Go subscription through CLIProxyAPI: the Go models of a workspace over Chat Completions, Messages and Responses, the workspace's opt-in OpenCode Zen pay-as-you-go models as opencode/..., OpenCode's free models as opencode-free/... with no account at all, each with a priority and weight of its own, an OpenCode login from the OAuth Login page or keys on a Management Center page that also enables and disables models, one setting that serves every model under its bare ID to share it with other providers, and 5-hour, weekly and monthly quota in the Plugin tab.
plugins.author: Whexy

plugins.name: Reset First
plugins.description: Sends each request to the account whose quota resets soonest among those serving the model, so what an account has left is spent before its reset loses it. Reads Codex and Claude quota from responses and their usage endpoints; a Management Center page shows each model's latest choice and why.
plugins.author: Whexy

plugins.name: System Prompts
plugins.description: Appends your own text to the system prompt of requests for the models you choose, before CLIProxyAPI translates or cloaks them. Rules pair model IDs or wildcard patterns with a prompt and are managed on a Management Center page.
plugins.author: Whexy

plugins.name: Usage Dashboard
plugins.description: Adds a Usage page to Management Center: processed tokens, estimated cost, sessions and cache savings over the past day, week, month or quarter, grouped by model family or by account and kept on disk, and the quota left in Claude, Codex, Grok, Meta and OpenCode Go accounts, recorded and projected.
plugins.author: Whexy

plugins.name: Zed
plugins.description: Serves a Zed account's hosted models through CLIProxyAPI. Claude, GPT and Gemini models come from the live Zed catalog with their own prefix, each in the protocol the client speaks, through a Zed sign-in from the OAuth Login page or an imported auth file, with a Management Center page that manages accounts and models, and plan and spend in the Plugin tab when a dashboard cookie is configured.
plugins.author: Whexy
